question: Only one HN control (DN0, time 0) was sequenced; no time-matched HN samples exist for DN3-DN96 or RN3-RN24. How should starvation and resupply contrasts be formed?
proposed_answer: Starvation: DNt vs DN0 (rank 1 vs 2, same tissue). Resupply: RNt vs DN96 (N added back) and optionally RNt vs DN0. Flag that time/plant age and diurnal effects are confounded with N in all contrasts.
evidence: PMC10454388 Methods 4.9: RNA-seq samples at 0, 3, 12, 24, 96 h after deprivation and 3, 12, 24 h after resupply; 48 libraries = 8 time points x 2 tissues x 3 reps (titles X-0, X-DNt, X-RNt).

question: Resupply samples (RN3/12/24) carry time_h = hours since resupply (the second N change, at 96 h of deprivation), while DN samples carry hours since deprivation onset. OK for time-matching?
proposed_answer: Yes: RNt pairs with DN96 (time_h 96 of the starvation phase) as its starved reference; the time-zero HN sample DN0 is phase steady, time_h 0.
